test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a Navratna company?
solution:
The correct answer is the __**Airports Authority of India**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The company that is NOT a Navratna company among the options listed is the Airports Authority of India.
 
• Navratna status is a recognition given by the Government of India to select public sector enterprises (PSEs) that have shown excellent performance and have the potential for further growth.
 
• This status allows these PSEs greater financial and operational autonomy compared to other public sector companies.
 
• It is responsible for creating, upgrading, maintaining, and managing civil aviation infrastructure in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Engineers India Limited (EIL): EIL is a Navratna company. It provides engineering consultancy and EPC services primarily focused on the oil and gas and petrochemical industries.
 
• Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL): BEL is a Navratna company. It is engaged in the design, development, and manufacture of electronics equipment mainly for the Indian defence services.
 
• Oil India Limited (OIL): OIL is a Navratna company. It is involved in the exploration, development, and production of crude oil and natural gas, transportation of crude oil, and production of LPG.
